input: Find therapeutic, speech, occupational therapy and social-skills summer camps for kids for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville occupational therapy summer camp 2026 social skills

candidates.name: We Rock the Spectrum – Asheville
candidates.note: Inclusive sensory-gym camps; 2025 programming emphasized social skills, cooperation and communication; 2026 camp served ages 3–7.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Therapeutic recreation summer camps alongside general youth camps; 2026 registration included a therapeutic-program category.

candidates.name: Christmount
candidates.note: Camp Lakey Gap offers weeklong autism camps for children and teens, with visually structured activities and 1:1 or 1:2 daytime support; 2026 registration confirmed.

candidates.name: Talisman Camps
candidates.note: Specialized adventure camps for ages 6–22 with autism, ADHD or learning differences; social-skills development and 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: North Carolina adventure camps for youth with ADHD and learning differences, emphasizing social interaction, coping skills and independence.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ruach and autism-inclusion program Camp Tikvah; current tuition page lists Tikvah, while Camp Ruach has announced summer 2027.
